items.q: Do I need any special hardware for QR Zaman?
items.a: No. Just print the QR code you generate in the panel and put it on the wall. Employees scan it with the QR Zaman app on their own phones.

items.q: Can an employee clock in for someone else?
items.a: No. Each account is bound to a single device, the phone's location is captured at the moment of scanning, and fake location apps are detected.

items.q: Is payroll calculated according to current regulations?
items.a: Tax brackets, social security rates, minimum wage exemptions, severance and notice rules and public holidays are kept per year and copied to the new year in one click.

items.q: Can I manage more than one company and branch?
items.a: Yes. QR Zaman works with a group, company, branch and department hierarchy, and every user gets their own access scope.

items.q: How do I import my existing employee list?
items.a: Download the ready Excel template, fill it in and import it in one go; you get a result report for every row.

qrPdks.intro: With QR code attendance, employees clock in and out by scanning the QR code at their workplace with their own phone. Their location is captured at the moment of the scan, fake GPS is detected and each account is paired to a single device. Records reach the panel instantly and move to the timesheet daily or monthly.

benefits.title: Start without card readers
benefits.text: A printable A4 QR poster and your employees' own phones are all you need. No fingerprint scanners, badges or installation crew.

benefits.title: Location and device checks
benefits.text: The scan location is stored with each record, clock-ins from fake GPS are blocked and an account cannot be used from another phone.

benefits.title: From clock-in to timesheet
benefits.text: Transfer attendance records to the timesheet daily or monthly, so nobody adds up hours by hand at month end.

showcase.title:
Every punch,

on the record.
showcase.text: Clock-in and clock-out times, regular hours, overtime and leave appear on one screen. Open any record to see which location it was scanned at, down to the latitude and longitude. Filter by department and date range, correct a wrong time or clear a record, and employees get a warning on duplicate entries such as a second clock-in on the same day.

steps.title:
Set up in

three steps.
items: Define a location for each department with latitude and longitude in the panel, or save your current spot in one tap from the mobile app on site.
Download the location's QR code as a PNG or as a print-ready A4 PDF poster and put it up at the entrance.
Employees choose Clock in or Clock out in the app and scan the code; the location is verified and the record lands in the panel.

qrPdks.capabilitiesText: QR code attendance shares its data with shift definitions and timesheets. When allowed, employees view their own attendance records on mobile, while managers follow late arrivals, absences and overtime in the reports. Because every record keeps its clock-in, clock-out, regular hours and overtime, month end brings a ready timesheet instead of a debate.

shiftManagement.intro: Shift management software lets you set up shift definitions for each branch and department. Once night shifts, break times and weekly rest days are defined, total working, break and overtime hours are calculated automatically, and QR code attendance records flow into the timesheet according to those rules.

benefits.title: Shifts per branch and department
benefits.text: If your store, production line and office work different hours, give each its own shift; shift work and the weekly rest day are set on the employee profile.

benefits.title: Hours past midnight
benefits.text: The night shift option covers work that runs past midnight, and working and break times are calculated against the shift.

benefits.title: Breaks and overtime handled
benefits.text: Total working, break and overtime hours come straight from the shift definition, with daily and monthly totals on the overtime sheet.

showcase.title:
Overtime,

accounted for.
showcase.text: The overtime sheet shows every employee's daily overtime and monthly totals in one table. Filter by branch, department and month to focus on a team; overtime calculated from the shift rules moves into the timesheet and from there into payroll. The attendance report also lists late arrivals, late departures, absences and who worked overtime.

steps.title:
Shifts ready in

three steps.
items: Pick a branch and department, then enter the shift's working hours, break time and, if needed, the night shift option.
Mark shift work and the weekly rest day on each employee profile.
As employees scan in, working, break and overtime hours are calculated against the shift and moved to the timesheet.

shiftManagement.capabilitiesText: Shift definitions are the foundation of attendance and timesheets. Create separate rules for production lines, stores or night teams and compare the results on the overtime sheet and in the attendance report. Every output exports to Excel, PDF or Word.

problems.title:
Why is month end

so exhausting?
problems.text: Most of a payroll team's time goes into collecting and checking data, not into the calculation itself. QR Zaman shortens the work in three places.

items.title: Hours added up by hand
items.text: When clock-in times are gathered from paper sheets, different devices or messages and typed into a timesheet, it costs time and invites mistakes. Overtime and leave days still have to be checked separately.

items.title: Rules change every year
items.text: Tax brackets, social security rates, minimum wage exemptions, severance and notice rules are updated every year. If those values live in spreadsheets outside your payroll software, the risk of using the wrong rate never goes away.

items.title: The same data, entered again and again
items.text: Bonuses, advance deductions and leave arrive from different people in different formats. Moving each one into payroll separately becomes a serious workload across a large headcount.

features.title:
Key features for

HR and payroll
features.text: Every module, from the employee profile to the payroll report, shares the same data. You enter something once.

items.timesheet: Transfer attendance into the timesheet daily or monthly and fill gaps with bulk entry.
items.payroll: Calculate payroll for everyone or a selection in one click, then review and approve.
items.earningsDeductions: Add bonuses, overtime and deductions to many employees in a single entry.
items.compliance: Tax brackets, coefficients, severance and notice rules are kept per year and carried to the next year in one click.
items.employeeManagement: Bulk import staff from an Excel template and keep tax and social security settings on each profile.
items.hrDocuments: Download ready-made HR templates such as employment contracts, timesheet forms and incident reports.

splits.title:

in one flow.
splits.text: When the timesheet is complete, calculate payroll for all staff or for selected employees. Regular, night, public holiday and collective agreement overtime, travel and meal pay, family and child allowances, social security contributions, income tax, stamp duty, minimum wage exemptions and pension deductions are all calculated line by line.

faq.a: Every employee clocks in from their own phone, so nobody queues at a single device. You can put a QR point at the factory gate or a separate one for each department.

faq.q: Can different departments have different shifts?
faq.a: Yes. Shifts are defined per branch and department, so production, warehouse and office teams can each have their own hours and break lengths.

faq.q: How does overtime reach payroll?
faq.a: Overtime moves into the timesheet and is calculated in payroll as separate regular, night, public holiday and collective agreement overtime lines. Extra overtime by day, hour or amount can also be added on the earnings screen.

construction.intro: Construction time tracking has to work without a fixed front door. With QR Zaman, crews scan the QR code posted on site and their location is added to the record, while clock-ins made with fake GPS are blocked. Managers set up the QR point for a new job site from the mobile app, in one tap, right where they stand.

problems.title:
Who worked where,

on site and in the field?
problems.text: Construction and field crews move often, job sites are temporary and managers are rarely on site. That makes reliable attendance records hard to keep.

items.title: Work locations keep changing
items.text: One site finishes, another starts, and field crews may work at several spots in a day. Installing a device or running cables at every new location is slow and expensive.

items.title: Records you can't trust
items.text: Paper sign-in sheets and foremen's notes don't prove someone was actually on site. Buddy punching and hours fixed after the fact go straight into payroll as cost.

items.title: Remote crews, late information
items.text: If attendance from the field reaches the office days later, you can't see in time which crew worked how many hours at which site, or close the timesheet accurately.

features.title:
Key features for

construction and field teams
features.text: Start without hardware or cabling: all you need is a QR poster and your crew's phones.

items.qrPdks: The scan location is stored with its accuracy, and clock-ins made with fake GPS are blocked.
items.locationTracking: Set up each job site as a location linked to a department and deactivate it when work is done.
items.mobileApp: Managers create a new QR point on site by saving their current location in one tap.
items.timesheet: Field records move into the timesheet, so every crew's monthly hours and overtime are in one grid.
items.payroll: Payroll for daily or hourly paid field staff is calculated automatically from the timesheet.

splits.title:
Scan on site,

location on record.
splits.text: Crew members choose Clock in or Clock out in the app and scan the QR code on site. The phone's location is added to the record with its accuracy, and if location is off the app sends them to settings. Each account is paired to one device so it can't be used from another phone, and no camera image is ever saved.
points: Device pairing: one account, one phone

splits.title:
Latitude and longitude

on every record.
splits.text: Open any clock-in in the panel to see the time, the location and the latitude and longitude where the QR code was scanned. Filter by department and date range to review each site separately, and correct a time or clear a record when needed.

faq.q: How do we add a new job site?
faq.a: When a manager arrives on site, they pick the department in the mobile app and save their current location in one tap. They then download the location's QR code as a PNG or A4 PDF poster and put it up at the site entrance.

faq.q: Can someone clock in when they're not on site?
faq.a: The phone's location is captured at the moment of the scan and stored with the record, including latitude and longitude. Clock-ins from fake GPS apps are detected and blocked, and because each account is paired to one device, nobody can scan on someone else's behalf.

faq.q: What happens to the QR code when a site is finished?
faq.a: Instead of deleting the location, you set it to inactive. That way the clock-ins already recorded at that site stay in your attendance records and reports.

faq.q: Our field crews are paid daily. Does payroll support that?
faq.a: Yes. On each employee profile you choose monthly, daily or hourly pay, as net or gross. Payroll is calculated from the days and hours in the timesheet.

hospitality.intro: Restaurant shift scheduling has to keep up with hours that never stay the same. With QR Zaman, staff in restaurants, cafés and hotels start their shift by scanning a QR code, and breaks and overtime are calculated against the shift. Timesheets and payroll for hourly, daily and monthly paid staff are prepared in the same panel.

problems.title:
Why restaurant shifts

never stand still
problems.text: In restaurants, cafés and hotels, the workload changes by the hour, the day and the season. Staffing follows, but time tracking often can't keep up.

items.title: Variable and split shifts
items.text: Split shifts for lunch and dinner service, busy weekends and rotating days off quickly break any tracking method built around fixed office hours.

items.title: Overtime down to the minute
items.text: When service runs late, closing time slips. If overtime and breaks aren't recorded properly, staff feel short-changed and the business can't see its real labour cost.

items.title: Mixed pay types
items.text: Salaried staff work alongside daily or hourly paid helpers in the same venue. Calculating each group's pay in a different spreadsheet drags out month end.

features.title:
Key features for

restaurants and hospitality
features.text: Define separate shifts for kitchen, floor and housekeeping, and bring them all together in one timesheet.

items.shiftManagement: Set shifts, break lengths and days off per department; working time and overtime are calculated automatically.
items.qrPdks: Staff scan the QR code at the staff entrance with their own phone; no cards or devices needed.
items.timesheet: See daily overtime and monthly totals per department on the overtime sheet.
items.payroll: Payroll for monthly, daily and hourly paid staff is calculated automatically from the timesheet on one screen.
items.earningsDeductions: Add bonuses and deductions as net or gross amounts to many employees in one entry.
items.leaveManagement: Staff request leave on mobile and managers approve with the remaining balance in view.

splits.title:
Late service,

no lost overtime.
splits.text: QR clock-ins are split into regular hours, breaks and overtime according to the shift and appear on the overtime sheet. Filter by branch, department and month to see where the overtime is going, then move the records into the timesheet.
points: Overtime sheet by department and month

splits.title:
Bonuses and extras,

ready in payroll.
splits.text: Define bonuses and other extra earnings as net or gross amounts with a payment date, and enter deductions and overtime by day, hour or amount on the same screen. One entry can cover many employees, and everything flows into payroll automatically.

faq.q: Can we track split shifts?
faq.a: Staff scan the QR code at the start and end of each shift. Records are calculated as regular hours, breaks and overtime according to your shift definitions and transferred to the timesheet.

faq.q: Does payroll work for hourly paid staff?
faq.a: Yes. On each employee profile you choose monthly, daily or hourly pay, as net or gross. Payroll is calculated automatically from the day and hour payments in the timesheet.

faq.q: We run several restaurants. Can we manage them all in one place?
faq.a: Yes. Set up each restaurant as a branch and areas such as kitchen and floor as departments. Switch between restaurants from the top bar and run reports per branch.

faq.q: Can staff see their own hours?
faq.a: If you allow it in company settings, staff see their attendance records and timesheet in the mobile app. The today card on the home screen also shows their live working time.

healthcare.intro: Healthcare staff scheduling and attendance have to be reliable around the clock. With QR Zaman, staff at hospitals, clinics and care providers clock in and out by scanning a QR code with their own phone. Night shifts, leave, timesheets and payroll are all managed together in one panel.

problems.title:
Why healthcare

is different
problems.text: Healthcare providers never close. Shift patterns, leave planning and staff records need more care here than in most industries.

items.title: Round-the-clock rotas
items.text: Night, weekend and public holiday shifts are routine in healthcare. When working time, breaks and overtime for shifts that run past midnight are calculated by hand, timesheets stop adding up.

items.title: Leave that needs paperwork
items.text: When sick leave and other documented absences are requested, evidenced and approved through different channels, documents get lost and leave balances end up wrong.

items.title: Many units, many teams
items.text: Emergency, outpatient, laboratory and administrative units all keep different hours. Collecting attendance from each one separately delays the overall picture for management.

features.title:
Key features for

healthcare providers
features.text: Set up units as departments, each with its own shifts and QR check-in point. Everything comes together in one timesheet and payroll.

items.shiftManagement: Define shifts per unit with night shifts, breaks and days off; hours are calculated automatically.
items.qrPdks: Staff scan the QR code at their unit; location and device checks keep every record reliable.
items.leaveManagement: Attach files such as medical certificates to leave requests; managers approve with the balance in view.
items.timesheet: Keep monthly timesheets per unit with day types such as public holiday, annual leave and excused absence.
items.employeeRecords: Keep each employee's file, including identity, education and health details, in one place.
items.payroll: Night and public holiday overtime are calculated automatically as separate payroll lines.

splits.title:
Documented leave

in one flow.
splits.text: Staff send leave requests from mobile and can add hourly leave, a leave address, a message and attachments such as medical certificates. Seniority, entitlement, used and remaining leave are calculated automatically on the request. Managers approve, or decline with a reason, and all leave and requests are listed on separate tabs.

splits.title:
Unit timesheets,

ready every month.
splits.text: Attendance is transferred to the timesheet daily or monthly. The timesheet grid shows day types such as working day, weekly rest, public holiday, annual leave and excused absence, which you can mark quickly from the toolbar. The overtime sheet shows daily overtime by unit and month.
points: Overtime sheet by unit and month

faq.q: How are on-call and night shifts calculated?
faq.a: In the shift definition you set the night shift, break length and weekly rest day. Total working time, breaks and overtime are calculated automatically from QR clock-ins, and payroll shows night and public holiday overtime as separate lines.

faq.q: Can medical certificates be attached to leave requests?
faq.a: Yes. Files can be attached to leave requests. The manager sees the attachment while reviewing the request and approves it or declines it with a reason.

faq.q: Can each unit have its own QR point?
faq.a: Yes. Locations are linked to departments, so you can create a separate QR point for each unit, such as the emergency department, outpatient clinic or laboratory, and put it up at its entrance.

faq.q: How is staff information protected?
faq.a: Each user sees only the menus and data defined for their role and scope. In the mobile app, session data is kept in encrypted device storage, and no camera image is saved when scanning a QR code.

education.intro: School staff attendance tracking has to follow the academic calendar. With QR Zaman, teachers and administrative staff at schools, training centres and colleges clock in and out by scanning a QR code. Manage leave, timesheets and payroll for each campus as a branch, all in one panel.

problems.title:
What makes school

staff tracking different
problems.text: In education, the working pattern follows the timetable, terms and holidays. Staff attendance tracking has to fit that rhythm.

items.title: Work tied to the calendar
items.text: Public holidays, half days and term breaks change the working days of teachers and office staff. If those days aren't marked correctly in the timesheet, the number of days worked never adds up.

items.title: Different staff groups
items.text: Teachers, administrative staff, cleaning and security teams work different hours on different patterns. Tracking them all against one schedule doesn't reflect reality.

items.title: More than one campus
items.text: For institutions with several buildings or campuses, collecting attendance and leave from each one separately doubles the work for central HR.

features.title:
Key features for

schools and colleges
features.text: Set up campuses as branches and units as departments, and use staff groups to separate teaching and administrative staff.

items.qrPdks: Teachers and office staff scan the QR code at the building entrance with their own phone.
items.leaveManagement: Leave requests arrive from mobile; managers approve with the balance in view and run leave reports.
items.timesheet: Keep monthly timesheets per campus with day types such as public holidays and annual leave.
items.payroll: Once the timesheet is complete, calculate and approve payroll for all staff automatically.
items.multiCompany: Set up each campus as a branch and switch between them from the top bar.
items.hrDocuments: Download ready templates such as employment contracts, paid leave request forms and timesheet forms.

splits.title:
Who took how much leave,

in one report.
splits.text: The leave usage report shows the leave each employee has taken, and the annual leave report shows each person's seniority, entitlement, used and remaining days. Export reports to Excel, PDF or Word and use them for term planning.

splits.title:
Campuses and units

in one structure.
splits.text: Build your institution with a Group, Company, Branch and Department hierarchy. Each campus is a branch and each unit a department, with location, person in charge and working hours stored on the department card. Give users a scope so they only see their own campus.
points: Working hours on each department card

faq.q: How do public holidays and term breaks show up in the timesheet?
faq.a: Public holidays and half days are defined in the yearly settings and shown on the calendar. On the timesheet grid you can mark day types such as public holiday, weekly rest and annual leave one by one or in bulk from the toolbar.

faq.q: Teachers and office staff keep different hours. Is that supported?
faq.a: Yes. Use staff groups to separate teams and define different shifts per branch and department. Each person's working time is calculated against their own shift.

faq.q: We have several campuses. Is each one managed separately?
faq.a: All campuses sit in the same panel as branches. Central managers see everything, while campus managers get a scope that shows only their own branch.

faq.q: What do the ready-made document templates cover?
faq.a: Templates include fixed-term and permanent employment contracts, hiring and job application forms, paid leave request forms, annual paid leave records, monthly timesheet forms and absence reports. Search for a document and download it in one click.

multiBranch.intro: Multi-location workforce management starts with every branch in one panel. In QR Zaman you build your Group, Company, Branch and Department structure and give each branch its own QR check-in point. Branch managers see only their own branch, while timesheets and payroll are run centrally.

problems.title:
Why control slips

as you add branches
problems.text: Once you open a second, third or tenth branch, people processes start to run differently in each one, and head office spends its time collecting data.

items.title: A different method in every branch
items.text: If one branch uses a sign-in sheet, another a card reader and another a spreadsheet, central HR has to merge different formats every month and can't compare branches.

items.title: Everyone sees everything, or nothing
items.text: Branch managers should see only their own people while head office sees every branch. Without proper access scopes, either privacy or day-to-day operations suffer.

items.title: Several companies, one payroll team
items.text: When a group runs several legal entities, each company's payroll is calculated with its own settings. Using separate software for each adds cost and risk.

features.title:
Key features for

multi-branch businesses
features.text: Opening a new branch is as simple as adding a branch record and a QR point in the panel.

items.multiCompany: Build your group, company, branch and department hierarchy and switch between them from the top bar.
items.rolesPermissions: Give users a scope at group, company or branch level and keep track of their last sign-in.
items.locationTracking: Create a separate QR point for each branch entrance and print it as an A4 poster.
items.dashboard: The manager dashboard shows active staff, clock-ins and pending requests for the selected branch.
items.reporting: Pick a branch from the top bar to run attendance, leave, advance and payroll reports and share them as Excel or PDF.
items.payroll: Run payroll for every company centrally, using the same yearly settings.

splits.title:
Each manager sees

their own branch.
splits.text: In user management you add users, set their role and define their scope at group, company or branch level. A branch manager sees only their branch's staff, records and requests, while head office managers see the whole structure. Every user's last sign-in is listed in the same place.

splits.title:
Bring new branches

online fast.
splits.text: When you add a new branch to your structure, define its department locations with latitude and longitude, or let the branch manager save their current spot in one tap from the mobile app. Download the QR code as a PNG or A4 PDF poster and put it up at the entrance; the branch team starts clocking in with their own phones.

faq.q: Can we manage different companies in the same account?
faq.a: Yes. QR Zaman works with a Group, Company, Branch and Department hierarchy. You can set up several companies under one group and manage each company's branches and departments separately.

faq.q: Can a branch manager see other branches' data?
faq.a: Not unless you allow it. In user management you set each user's scope at group, company or branch level.

faq.q: Can we compare branches?
faq.a: Pick a branch from the top bar to run its attendance, leave, advance and payroll reports. Export them to Excel, PDF or Word to compare branches side by side.

faq.q: What do we do when an employee moves to another branch?
faq.a: Just update the branch and department on the employee's profile. They then clock in at the new branch's QR point.
